facts.after: The account page can display the authenticated account owner's persisted attachment total.
facts.before: The account statistics response did not include the new attachment storage field.
conditions: The total includes unlinked uploads and attachments across spaces.
The total excludes temporary uploads and derived files.
A memo filter does not restrict the account storage total.
Other users and anonymous users do not receive the private storage field.
Attachment deletion refreshes statistics after success or failure because the server can delete rows before a cleanup failure.
The account page shows an ellipsis before the statistic arrives. A zero total shows zero bytes.
A failed statistics request shows an unavailable message instead of a zero total.
The change also shares the statistic row component and removes two unused attachment mutation hooks.
facts.mechanism: The account page requests user statistics. The service checks ownership and sums attachment sizes through the database driver.

limits: The added tests exist in the reviewed source, but this case preparation did not execute them.
The total describes database attachment sizes rather than measured filesystem consumption.
These captures verify the frontend display with synthetic service responses.
They execute no Memos backend, database, authorization, or application test suite.
